text: I have played the game daily for many years, and the latest update is quite frankly a game killer. The huge increase in costs with getting a lot less for your money is an insult to us long-term players. I would always buy the pass when it was £5.99, now it's £8.99 and for some £9.99 there is no way I will buy nor in-app purchases. The game is no longer enjoyable. How I'm feeling I may just delete the app, which is a shame as I'm in a fantastic team, many of which feel the same.

Played this for years and really enjoyed it. It's a match game with other activities. However recent changes make it no longer enjoyable☹. The gold pass is now too short and is focussed on passing levels instead of tasks. I'm assuming the developers are just plain greedy. And this is from someone who always paid for special passes and events previously. No more. I'm playing Royal Match instead. I'd recommend you download that instead of Fishdom

A fun little game for when you're bored but it does seem to have become more "impossible" - the games are rigged, to encourage you to either use all your boosters (so you'll end up buying more), or pay for extra moves to complete the level. Either way, they want you to spend your real, hard-earned money. I refuse to spend my money on progressing in this game. I also think there should be an opt-out option on the challenge levels.

Played this game for ages. Got nowhere. Super hard levels are boring and time consuming. The idea is to get people to spend money to beat them. Too few rewards for too much time and effort. Other players have told the developers all this again and again - but nothing has changed. Developers dont care. Have deleted. Won't bother again.

I had originally rated this game with 5 stars. Now that I've got through a few levels the game has not only become extremely difficult to the point it is boring, I have found that certain actions are not completed. For example if I get rid of an obstruction it still remains. I am continually asked to rate the game even though I already had. Continually asked to buy items. Good game ruined

After 2 months of playing I have to say this game was made for rich people only. No matter how many boosters do you use, or how many extra lifes do you buy, some levels are uncompletable. I stopped playing at level 769, which I tried to complete 138 times (yes I counted), unsuccessfully. I know that business is about revenue, and nothing wrong with that. Yet, I think it would be better if you sold the game for a relatively high price and you would make it more enjoyable at the same time.

An additive and enjoyable game similar to the style of Candy Crush. I would rate higher, however the game is not what is advertised elsewhere, where you collect numbers to eat larger fish, which was the whole reason I installed the game. I have continued to play it, although am disappointed you can't do what the adverts say you can, which is misleading.

Played a demo in an ad, and it had a genuinely innovative game mechanic involving levelling up a fish by consuming others that was quite fun, so I downloaded. Only to discover that that isn't the game at all - this is a generic match 3 with a build-an-aquarium concept stapled on. If you have so little faith in your own game that you have to advertise it as something completely different to get me to download it, why should I bother playing it?

Free to download, but now expensive to play! Was enjoyable, but recent changes are very unfair. Some players get bonus passes, others don't. If you want to purchase the bonus pass, they now only last less than 7 days, rather than 3 or 4 weeks, but still cost £4.99. I'm in an amazing team, that are all now feeling the same way. Unless Fishdom reverts then I would not recommend playing this game and I suspect the company will be loosing a lot of players/revenue.

What everyone else is saying! It's become far too expensive, mini games have gone, always have to buy gems to complete, something ridiculous like 10 moves on hard & super hard levels which is just stupid, and don't tell me there's no compulsion to buy because I'm way past level 7000 & have been playing for years-I'm addicted!! I have to play daily & have so far this year spent a fortune, I'm scared to even count up how much I've spent! Why don't you actually listen to your players & sort it out!

The game was advertised as an awesome action game where you swim around and eat other fish with dynamic controls and get to grow bigger as you play. Nope. It's just another candy crush clone. WE'RE SICK OF THIS! If you have the ability to come up with a game that actually looks fun and even create an interactive ad that allows you to play it, why don't you just make that game!? I'm not interested in candy crush. This kind of dishonest advertising should be illegal. It's unethical.

Firstly, false advertising, advert is nothing like the game, so that's totally pathetic. Actual game is fun but a money-grabbing disgrace. I paid the £2.99 to open the fishy bank (a good name), as the game is fun and the developers are a business. However, little did I know its £2.99 every time which is completely ridiculous. I like that the game is difficult at times and fun, but forcing you to pay for rewards earned in game? Not good.

I installed this game because advert said it is a challange puzzle game, where you rescue some fish. It is nothing like that! Simple gem busting game. All levels nearly the same up to level 80 at least (I played it up to that so far, looking for those interesting levels, and didn't find them). Boring for someone older than 7. And they are nagging you all the time to spend some real money on addons.

Best Game. Easy to play. No ads really helps. Nice characters in the fish. Play casually to while away the hours. After playing for quite some time now I have to agree with another comment I jsut read. 1: What happened to the mini games ?There aren't any now 2: I have noticed a theme , it is subtle but after playing for so long you pick these things up. Nothing is random...Everything IS engineered to encourage the user to spend money. I have fallen into this trap. Play with this in mind.

out of the many other games i have played, this game comes close to the top of the 'sneaky' list. this game has been cleverly engineered for the user to spend money. it could be very addictive to the vulnerable. so, be warned. the game can be entertaining but, there is nothing random about the way the pieces drop into place. the powerups usually land exactly in the worst possible place....very frustrating. the treasure hunts and fish worlds are quite good but, again, engineered to bankrupt you

Disgusted! I've played this game happily for many years but feel super cheated now. I always buy a gold pass but if this isn't fixed I won't be spending any more money. 1 week pass for the same price as a month has always been? While I've always been able to justify spending a fiver a month, there is no way I can justify or afford to quadruple that to 20, especially during the current cost of living crisis! What a rotten scam fishdom and great way to lose dedicated long time players!!

I've been playing this game almost daily for just over 2 years and I'm on level 16351. The latest update is truly awful! The game pass cost has risen 50%, and power ups are woeful as they have been reduced. Lots of the existing power ups I had have now gone. I will not be playing anymore but I'll check back every now and then to see if the makers of the game have seen sense and revert back to what it was.

I’ve been playing Fishdom for a long time, but with every update it just keeps getting worse. The game’s algorithm feels like it’s deliberately blocking progress unless you spend money. Sometimes you end up stuck on the same level for two weeks, which becomes incredibly boring. It honestly feels like the game is trying to force you into buying boosters or extra moves just to move forward. This isn’t fun anymore — it’s frustrating and exhausting.

FALSE ADVERTISING! While the advert shows the game as helping the fish to escape and avoid obstacles or pull pins out to save the fish, this is not what happens in the game. It is simply a match 3 game and that's it. You either have to spend money to buy lives, power ups and gems and get the piggy bank or you have to repeat levels over and over. In total the game is a massive lie about what you will be playing and not worth playing

This is a match-3+ game. If I knew that every level was going to be like Candy Crush, I would never have downloaded this game. I'm sorry to the developers for being so harsh but your advert is deceiving. I had to delete your game because I had enough of the repetitive nature of the game. Just because the fish can be fed and the items can be added to the fish tanks, this does not make up for the lack of diversity in the game itself.

I've played this for years, got that far I run out of levels, but it's really getting monotonous, it's the same side game over and over, used to be different ones, I carried on playing, however, I went on today and they've changed it, the boosters are different and not as good, also, the season price has gone up £3, sorry guys but I'm out, I've uninstalled and won't be coming back.

If I could I would give no stars. Playrix has increased costs, less rewards. It is hard to pass levels unless you spend. They have changed rewards and boosters making to harder to get through a level. The cost of gold pass play has gone up. You can no longer get lives from Facebook friends. I won't spend, so I struggle to move through the levels. If it was not for my team players, I would give up. If you play this game, do not spend as it could cost you a fortune.

I used to love this game, but recent changes have made it much less enjoyable. As others have said the new changes to the seasons not only means it's near impossible to earn any rewards due to constant hard levels, but it also costs 4x more. My other issue is that almost daily a message pops up to say I need to make space to play, but I know full well that there is space on my phone. This stops me from being able to play altogether. Also team rewards should be shared by active players only imho.

To start with i highly enjoyed the game but found the higher levels extremely difficult 80+. i am bow stuck on 156. even purchasing diamonds and extra time didn't help on some levels. and how much should we have to pay to be able to play a game?reviews of the game from other players confirms this is a difficult game. i am not the only one having this problem. unfortunately i have given up and will have to just uninstall.

Was fun in the start, played a lot and even paid for stuff including the monthly pass. But eventually it just became too pay to win. The levels have too few moves you have to have extras to beat them(which you have to pay for then). Very addictive game and well done they got some money out of me but took it too far. Kept it less obnoxiously pay to win and i might have stuck around and spent more. Deleted now. Also the game is nothing like the ads or picture, thats just a mini game inside.

Really getting bored with this game now! Unless you are prepared to spend a lot of money to get the various power ups it is almost impossible to make progress. The seasons used to enable you to get power ups free but they have disappeared! Any extra time must be used immediately or lost! Mini-games, another source of bonuses also seem to have disappeared! I gave up on it once before then came back in lockdown, now I am injured so play for entertainment. When I get fit again will leave for good!

Another one of their games where the ad is false. The game itself has nothing to do with the fun demo game you play in the ad. The demo game is a "mini" game that only comes up as seasonal. False advertising. It's just a match 3 game and I'm bored of those. That's why I downloaded the game. I got the same old thing. This is sooooo boring. If it was as advertised I'd probably invest in it. Just thought I'd say that since it sounds like the creators are only motivated by money and not entertainmnt

edit 5/16/25 I have downgraded my opinion. Major changes to power-ups system. Loss of items previously earned for very thin excuses. It's "Pay to Play" has gotten more expensive. I've played for years, and with the most recent update, I think it may be time to move on. Disappointing to say the least. Fishdom, we had some good times, but your greed has destroyed our bond.

The first thing to say is that this is definitely not candy crush. Sure, you move candy-looking objects into patterns which then explode and you get combos of four or more which then give you boosters and allow you to explode more candy-looking items and the more explosions you get he more bonuses your get and you eventually run out of lives, more of which can then be purchased for real money to fulfil your need to get to the next level on an endless quest to win. But this has fish tanks.

Like other reviewers, I was drawn to this game by the Save The Fish adverts. As with others of its kind, it's nothing of the sort, with only a few Save The Fish minigames early on to justify the adverts and stave off any false advertising litigation. Once I got to level 60 and hadn't encountered a minigame for about 40 levels I uninstalled the game.

Installed it based on a false add. But as it had been a while since I had a match 3 game installed decided I might play it anyway. Starts off okay with the level indication to get you into it I guess, but at some stage the "easy" games become more difficult than the hard ones just to get you to buy power-ups.

Saw the ad in another game but due to the ridiculous amount of false advertising I'm seeing lately, I thought I would check the reviews. Surprise surprise, its nothing like the actual gameplay. I havent even bothered to install it - as soon as I read it's a match 3 I was bored. The advertising literally couldn't be any more different to the game. Reported

A fun time wasting game but a few annoying features... Squid levels, the squid are less inclined to appear when you're close to completion. There are times when doing well is actually detrimental. You cannot chose when to use your rewards. The allocation of when you get a bronze/silver/gold ticket seems totally random, it'd make much more sense if all basic levels gave bronze, hard silver and extra hard gold.

Edit.. June 2023...Been playing this for around 8 years, and still love it, the only game with no annoying adverts. However, the creators are getting greedy! Gold pass used to last around a month, now about 2 weeks! Plus, the price has risen!Can't finish it now without paying out more. Free prizes are almost non-existent, and levels are ridiculously hard to do now without paying. Before, they were hard but doable. Sort it before you lose player base. Just read players facebook groups to see!

The game is impossible, it's clearly set so at a point you have to pay for extras which I just refuse to do. Its me at to be a destresser not add to your stresses. Which this definitely does. The items at so expensive which makes it extremely difficult to move onto the next fishbowl. This is coming from someone who actually gave it a chance and is at level 1168. Disgraceful. Not that this will even make a difference or that they will even read this review.

False advertising! This game is not what is shown in the advertisement. It looks like a fun game where you go through little puzzles to save your fish but instead it is more like candy crush only worse. Annoyed that I have wasted time downloading this. How these companies are getting away with this is beyond me. DO NOT DOWNLOAD IF YOU ARE LOOKING TO PLAY THE GAME ADVERTISED.

I have been playing this game for quite some time, the graphics are good, but is now becoming very expensive. you no longer get as many couns when feeding the fish and the 'beauty' points for the tanks is nearly impossible to reach without spending a lor of money. the occasional sale days are lot more expensive as you progress through the tanks, I am getting to tje stage of unistalling the game

It starts off fun but it is not free. It becomes impossible to get to the next level and I have not got money to waste because it becomes ridiculously expensive. For the money you could play on this game you could get a small aquarium of your own. I know I've kept fish. Don't bother. It ends up frustrating because also the tiles will not move as quickly as you want or will stick when you try to get to the next level- total con. A bit fishy🦈🤣

It's a cute game, nothing innovative but good graphics and sounds for a free game. My gripe is that if you don't make a move within 3 seconds it tells you what next to do which completely takes any sense of achievement out of it because you're just being told how to play. It takes more than 3 seconds to look at the whole board! There's no way to turn this feature off either and for that reason, I'm uninstalling as these games are dime a dozen. Shame because I got a little attached to my fish.

Where do I even start? This game is falsely advertised, it's basically candy crush, not the puzzle solving, guide the fish through tu sewers game you see in the trailers. Secondly, the game is ridiculously expensive, and is rigged so you always lose even when you play really well. Absolute wast of time, space and energy. Wish I could rate lower than 1 star. DO NOT DOWNLOAD

This game was fun, challenging and exciting at the first few levels. I delighted in receiving new aquariums and naming all my fish. Then, as it became harder, it became more transparent that it is a pay-to-play game. Although multiple times it was explained that you can play without paying, that proved to be false. You can "win" by accident depending on the randomness of the setup, but you cannot play without powerups (that you buy) and additional moves (that you buy). Even when a diamond is rel

I can't give this a star rating yet. I can't really say that I have seen much of the game yet. But it feels like false advertising. The ads that I saw for this game were like "eat things smaller than you" as a real-time, as you are moving thing. They looked non-trivial, and like their was need for reaction and timing. So far, nothing like that. The game is a generic match 3, and those "eat things smaller than than you" parts are only occasional, and are simple tap the number smaller than you.

Game is broken again. I seen people post about # of moves being off on certain boards. I'm on level 4088. There is no way to beat that board in 14 moves. I think I heard someone else say they were given 14 moves on a different board and was stuck. Super annoying. I used all 3 power ups and played on and was still a couple moves away from beating it. Until the game is fixed I'll take a break from it. (Obviously I'm good at the game, I'm on level 4088). I'm probably overdue for a break anyway lol

I was going to download this game because the ad showed that this was a "pick what tool is best" kind of game which looked fun but then looking at the pictures and reading all the reviews, that is not the case. This is just another candy crush type game but with fish. That's a shame, you guys could've had somthing really good if you had just created what was in your ad. You shouldn't make fake ads just to get people to download your stuff.

I downloaded this game after seeing an ad for it in another game. The advert made it look like a great game where making decisions to move pieces to good a fish through a course to safety. IT IS NOT THAT GAME! This is a match 3 game that clearly has to advertise itself as a definitely game in order to con people into downloading. Why not make the game your advertise? You'd make a mint! I have removed the app and reported the adverts as misleading.

I've now decided to uninstall the game. I was spending money on power ups just to get off 1 level I'd spent days on. Game cheats and was getting too hard on some levels. Plus you had to get 160, 000 points just to get 1 star. Wasn't enjoyable anymore. Was getting boring and tedious unfortunately which is a shame because I used to enjoy it.

Had been enjoying the game but it's now reached a point where every level feels as impossible as the last. The points for the special side stories suddenly dropped and I now routinely get 15 instead of the 90+. And the latest update has meant I have no 'season', which means no added daily bonuses, and no option to buy a season pass! So I'm now debating if it's even worth continuing playing!

This game is s**t. I updated it yet again on Monday and now it doesn't work at all. I paid for the gold pass and that money is going to waste. I've tried to email them but it says the email isn't supported anymore then followed the link they gave me. It asks for player ID and nick name but as I can't access anything in the game I can't get the details needed. What a waste of time and rip off. Not a happy chap at all.

I'm loving it so far, I've got upto level 226 now, the fish are so cute and its really fun!! Some of the levels are ridiculously hard though and almost impossible, it's takes me all my lives sometimes just too complete one level, but it just makes me feel victorious when I eventually beat it, lol. Good game, the best fish/aquarium match 3 game out, its awesome! 🐠🐟🐡🐙🐚

This is a very deceiving game, the ad allows you to take control of the fish & eat others to grow bigger. I've just played 5 mins of this game & am very disappointed. You don't get to play the style the ad shows, it's more like a candy crush game. The devs knew what they're doing, just wanting to get more downloads for profit from sponsors. I didn't even want to rate this a 1 star but had to, just so people could read this.

Good little game that drains the battery 😀 Why oh why have they dumbed down the graphics in the recent update, mean the bombs and stuff here. Really puts me off playing as feel im too old for it now.... ( im lvl 406 so not a new player ) This review was for a different game, can't remember the name. No idea why its on here as i have never played Fishdom... was going to try it as it was a different type of puzzle, but its the same old style.

Update. Not only do I have to wait for new levels for a week but also they are not new. So what is the point of making me wait if you just upload the ones from the previous week. Please sort it out. The game is good. However the new levels come up only 20 at a time. I am getting very frustrated having to wait for new ones every week for at least 4 days. I am missing on some of the extra games that cone up during the week.

Absolutely nothing to do with the game advertised. I gave it a good chance and played to level 28. Not one single time did the game play resemble the game that was advertised. The game play is very limited and is always prompting you to buy something with real money. A very poor spin on a game that has been done to death already. I want to give it no stars but it won't let me move forward with giving at least 1 star.

Sadly the developers have got very greedy. Gold pass costs £4.99 & used to last a month. Could accumulate rewards even if you were stuck on a level, and boosters were given for the duration. New pass costs the same, lasts a week, can't get rewards unless you pass levels, & boosters are very temporary. It entices people to spend more money when they are stuck. I won't be spending any more unless they go back to the old format. Sometimes fish refuse to eat, and this prevents you getting diamonds.

The game in the advert isn't the game you get . Complete misrepresentation, not even close to the same game. In the advert it shows a puzzle of moving lava and water around a tube system in order to "Save the fish" .....in reality you get presented with an aquarium you "buy" fish and ornaments for using coins you win playing a rip off version of candy crush (seas shells instead of candy)......played a few rounds to see if it progressed on to the game advertised but it doesn't...

This game is nothing like the adverts. The game was fun at first but its a game where you have to pay to win. Boosts and more moves cost too many diamonds and diamonds are not easy to get. The daily prizes are rubbish. Most the levels are too hard thus needing boosts (which cost) and it just stops being fun. Its an average game that needs a lot of work doing and the creators need to stop being greedy and wanting so much money or else people won't want to play the game!

I do enjoy this game but as with another lady who's posted a comment, I'm stuck in the same aquarium and have been for ages (4 weeks or so) despite having the three stars. Will give it a couple more days then maybe uninstall which is a shame. Given three stars for rating as I've enjoyed playing so far but will no longer be buying the boosters as there doesn't seem to be much point.

If I could give minus stars I would. I Gave it a second try, after deleting it some time ago, but deleted again after 1 day & 2 attempts to play. I won't bother with it again. What a waste of time. Despite having the infinity of lives for an hour, there are no games to access, you can't complete tasks with no games to play. "Support" is as useful as a chocolate teapot! It was nothing like the advert, which is totally misleading.

I've been playing for about a year or so, I totally love this game but as you progress you seem to get less incentives and harder levels, hardly ever see a mini-game either. I buy the gold pass but now its not come up leaving me playing with 5 lives on a hard level which is virtually impossible! Some players have totally different set up than others, I always update my fishdom but not sure that's a good idea. You seem to get less for more. Please listen to your customers imput

i love the game and have finished 2500 levels in about 9 months. The 'talking' fish are great as are the tanks and decorations. Levels are fairly hard, but interesting. Got hooked on it quickly. Why I am constantly being asked to review? Also, the game has lost its quirkiness since the introduction of teams. I am only playing occasionally now, but after 3 years this is bound to happen.

DO NOT INVEST IN THIS GAME. After about a month of play, the rules change, the game gets much harder, so that you have to pay. The change after 1 months means the player cannot reload each level at the start to try different arrangement of pieces. This makes some levels impossible. Therefore the game becomes stressful and unplayable. DO NOT INVEST YOUR TIME IN THIS GAME. They will lure you in only to make it so hard you have to pay money. So sad to see this

Expensive and repetitive. You only get 5 lives and buying more is expensive. Some levels are very difficult and have to be repeated countless times before they can be defeated unless you spend money on expensive power ups. If you fail a level you can continue playing, but it costs 99p for only 5 additional moves which is very expensive. I have no idea what the point of the aquarium is on what is just a puzzle game. UPDATE: why have you changed from clear crisp graphics to blocky fuzzy ones?

Addictive and the fish are adorable! It would be great if there was a way to 'speak' to them, even if it was via a yes/no/possible button. The ability for more interaction is something I would be willing to pay for, rather than the jewels which becomes ridiculous. For example: the first time I crossed two lighting bolts, it cleared the board, but the ones following would leave one tile and surprise, surprise - more jewels were needed to complete the level. 😑😵 Please consider giving more jewels in the purchase, a 'double your jewels' achievement, or even a jewel loyalty scheme. This is a superbly, positive visual game, but it does not come without a cost. Fix this, and you will gain more loyal customers.

Addiction at it's finest. I've been reading the feedback regarding the latest version which I've not downloaded due to the misconception that...I too took a double take and had to go out of purchasing the game in play store due to the disbelief that I encountered when I realized that it was the same game as prior, nothing had changed regarding the match up of shapes, bombs detonate if you time out etc etc. NOTHING LIKE THE ADVERT WHICH is a challenger for sharks vs little fish...WHY LIE? DON'T!

It's what you expect from a match three puzzle game, it contains quite a few microtransactions but I much prefer that to advertisements. Speaking of advertisements I find the minigames you sometimes unlock after a level a complete waste of time for me and whoever had to make them (not that it looks like a lot of time has been spent trying to make them, proberbly less than 5 minutes). They look like they are just there so the game can follow game trends like "pull the pin" type games.

Well. It is not, as it says in the ads, about dragging fish around and eating other ones. It is just another match three, which I am so fed up of, and no one likes. The only reason it doesn't get one star is because the gameplay outside of the match three is quite enjoyable, but to be able to do any of it you must complete the levels, some of which are so hard you get stuck on for days and can't progress. Uninstalled.

I enjoy playing this game but it can be so frustrating sometimes. You have targets on each level, for example you have to collect a certain number of bubbles.. you have 3 moves left and 1 bubble to collect and they're aren't any! You move three times and end the round as incomplete because the elusive bubble or other target piece isn't actually on the screen. This is incredibly frustrating and in my view a way to fleece the player to spend more diamonds, which you mostly have to pay for.

Cons: Wish you could choose where to put the boosters that you buy or earn as they always seem to be dumped in the most useless places or in a place that hinders the level. It takes too long to get new lives. A useful addition would be to have an option to buy 1 more move for less diamonds (currently 5 moves for 9) as often just one more move would complete the level. 9 diamonds seems excessive when you can top up your lives for the same amount. Pro's: LOVE this game - very addictive

(Edit:) Since leaving my review in 2016 the game has progressed significantly and been brought more in line with the other games of township and gardenscapes instead of playing second fiddle to them. It no longer crashes and is a perfect little fishie game to play. Lovely game to play but I can't help but feel progress is slow without power-ups. Fish animations and interactions are fun to watch however crash to desktops and not many coins per level completion tend to lead to slow progression.

Very addictive! It's a great game, but I get frustrated at the timed game. Sometimes you end up having to use more extras than I would like, given the restrictions. Also, I've gained the platinum horseshoe several times, but doesn't seem to move forward like the other levels. Graphics are great & love the water movement when you swipe the screen.

TOO MANY TIMED LEVELS!! Love the strategy of the game but the timed levels make me tense and aren't enjoyable and there are far too many. 🙁 Please consider that some of us (me) play it to relax... My favourite game. Play every day! Just one small request.... Please shorten the time to be able to skip level up animation. I don't want it and by the time the skip button comes up, they're almost over anyway! Wasting good playing time, please change 🙏🏾

It is nothing like the advert. It is continuing selling you stuff. I would not get the complete experience. I got up to level 63 and stopped as I got increasingly bored. The graphics were amazing and the different types of fish were creative. The game was addictive and relaxing. The colours were bright and cheerful. It is matching three symbols in a row type game. I just wished it was homestead in the advertising.

Game isn't what I saw in the ads. At level 1003 & still no fish to save in tunnels. Graphics are lovely and can decorate different themed aquariums, again are lovely & I enjoy it. But this is an expensive game to buy in game items. I notice when I've paid for more diamonds the levels seem to be beatable whereas not paying is a struggle to beat. I've spent too much & wasted too many hours that could have been spent more productively. Sorry game is a rip off. Good bye.

Love this game so much! It would help if, once I have earned coins and used them to 'buy' an accessory or a fish, that a green tick would appear by the item so that I'm not duplicating items in each aquarium. Also, I like that the game shows you how many gems you have when you fail a level, but now I'd also like to see a countdown appear when I have earned unlimited lives which shows how much free playtime I have left so that I don't have to keep exiting the level to see how much time is left.

Love Fishdom! Hours of fun. Well - it was till I got to level 26 which took me AGES to get out - but I did it! Great value (free!), great music and loads of fun. On the PC version my friend is on level 2393! She's been playing it for years 😀 It's now December 2019 and I've been stuck on level 1624 for about a month! I'm just about to give up! No actually it's given me years and years of fun and and loads of people are playing it now both at work and at home. It's a brilliant game!

Tired of downloading games after watching adverts that, it turns out, are not representative of game play in the slightest. I loathe match 3 games, but in the past few weeks I've sat through half a dozen of them from this lot hoping to find the puzzle/gameplay that was actually advertised. If it's in their games, I'm at a loss as to where.

A great game and completely free to play! You don't need to buy any add ons although it tries to persuade you to. If I lose my lives I leave the game and come back when they are full for free again (30 mins per life or something like that)! Is widely advertised as a puzzle game where you have to help a fish out of various traps. This is hugely misleading. What it is is a decent tile-matching game, with an aquarium building game added on - you buy fish and other things for your aquarium with the points you make matching tiles. Very occasionally, you are offered a "minigame", which is the puzzle game they advertised. However, I got to level 200+ and it was still showing me minigames with absolutely no challenge - in fact, they tell you what to do with arrows. It is clear that the minigames are an afterthought. So if you want to match tiles, then it is fairly good. But it is not what they advertise. The other element is that there are things like bombs and lightning flashs that you can earn, which will help you clear a screen. But you never have enough of them, which encourages you to spend real money buying them. The game is engineered to make you think "if only I had a couple more...". I managed to avoid the temptation to spend money, which I think was why I stopped progressing.

Oh... and no sign EVER of the cute minigame... false advertising! Beware! Avoid!
